source_caption:
📺 Criminal Minds (2005–Present)

Criminal Minds follows an elite team of FBI criminal profilers working in the Behavioral Analysis Unit (BAU) as they investigate some of America’s most disturbing and complicated crimes. Using psychology, behavioral analysis, and investigative skills, the team studies dangerous criminals to understand their motives and predict their next moves before more lives are lost. Led by experienced agents like Aaron Hotchner, David Rossi, and Emily Prentiss, the profilers face intense investigations, shocking discoveries, and dangerous confrontations while dealing with personal struggles outside their demanding careers. Filled with suspense, emotional moments, and unexpected twists, Criminal Minds explores justice, teamwork, human behavior, and the determination to protect innocent lives.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Mystery • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42–50 minutes per episode • TV-14/TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Jeff Davis

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ and Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Criminal Minds is a media franchise of American television programs created by Jeff Davis. The police procedural series follow the members of the Behavioral Analysis Unit (BAU) of the FBI. The inaugural television series aired on CBS from September 22, 2005 to February 19, 2020. In 2022, the series would be revived by Paramount+ under the title Criminal Minds: Evolution. Two spin-offs have been produced: Criminal Minds: Suspect Behavior on February 16, 2011, and Criminal Minds: Beyond Borders on March 16, 2016.
